info.title: Forever Logs External API
info.summary: Read-only access to aggregate combat-log statistics.
info.description: Public read-only API. Authenticate with an API key created from your profile settings. Public display of this data requires visible attribution linking back to the site; bulk redistribution of the dataset is not permitted.

stats:read.label: Aggregate data
stats:read.description: Class and spec statistics, content phases, boss metadata. Every key created from Profile Settings has this scope.

events:read.label: Event-level data
events:read.description: Individual combat events for one encounter at a time: swing timings, hit outcomes, casts, auras, deaths. Granted by hand to named projects rather than self-serve, because it is the most extraction-sensitive surface we publish.

research.note: Lower per-minute than partner on purpose: an event call does real database work, while a statistics call is served from a cache the site has already built.

bearerAuth.description: Send your key as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'. 'X-API-Key: <key>' is also accepted. Keys are NOT accepted in the query string.

Event.description: One combat event. timestamp_ms is milliseconds from that encounter's combat start, not a wall clock.

id.description: Event id. 64-bit, SERIALISED AS A STRING. Use it as an opaque identifier; do not parse it as a number.

timestamp_ms.description: Milliseconds since this encounter's combat start.

event_type.description: damage, heal, absorb, cast, death, or an avoidance outcome (parry, dodge, miss, block, ...). Outcome is encoded AS the event type, not as a field on a damage event.

amount.description: 64-bit, SERIALISED AS A STRING. Parse it before doing arithmetic or you will concatenate rather than add. Meaning depends on event_type: damage/heal value, absorbed amount, aura stack count on buff/debuff applied, overkill on death.

is_glancing.description: Glancing blow. Recorded on swing-derived rows only; null means NOT RECORDED (a non-swing event, or an encounter ingested before 2026-08-23). Null is not evidence the mechanic is absent.

is_crushing.description: Crushing blow. Same null semantics as is_glancing.

source_id.description: Actor id; resolve via the /actors endpoint.

spell_id.description: -1 is the melee sentinel: a white hit carrying no spell. A minority of genuine swings carry a real spell_id (weapon imbues, some pet melee), so prefer melee_only=true over filtering on -1 yourself.

melee_spell_id.description: The melee sentinel, published so it is not a magic number.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as ?cursor= for the next page. Null on the last page.

end_date.description: Null while the phase is the current one.

boss_id.description: Index on this, not on id: it is stable across zone recategorisation.

StatisticsResponse.description: `statistics` is keyed BY CLASS NAME, and each class's `specs` is keyed by spec name, so the key set is tenant-specific and changes with the game's class model. Iterate the keys; do not hardcode them.

error.description: Machine-readable code: missing_api_key, invalid_api_key, insufficient_scope, rate_limit_exceeded, daily_quota_exceeded, invalid_parameter, not_found, service_unavailable.

Unauthorized.description: Missing, unknown, or revoked API key.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit or daily quota exceeded. See the Retry-After header.

Forbidden.description: The key is valid but lacks the scope this endpoint requires. Event-level endpoints need 'events:read', which is granted by hand rather than self-serve.

NotFound.description: No such public resource. Returned identically for 'does not exist' and 'is not public', so it cannot be used to enumerate private reports.

get.description: Aggregate performance per class/spec for a content phase. Responses are cacheable for 30 minutes and carry an ETag.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Role filter. Omit for healing metrics.

get.description: Content phases and the locations belonging to each.
Boss metadata as a flat array. Index by boss_id, which is stable across zone recategorisation.

Newest public, fully-processed reports first. This is the entry point for event-level work: list reports, pick one, read its encounters, then read that encounter's events. Requires the 'events:read' scope.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only reports created at or after this ISO 8601 date.

get.summary: Get a report and its encounters
get.description: The report plus every encounter in it, with ids, names and durations. Only public, completed reports are addressable; anything else answers 404, including reports that exist but are private. Requires the 'events:read' scope.

The event stream for a single encounter, keyset paged.

**Timestamps** are `timestamp_ms`, milliseconds from that encounter's combat start, not a wall clock.

**Melee swings** are `event_type: "damage"` with `spell_id: -1`. A swing that did NOT land is its own event type instead: `parry`, `dodge`, `miss`, `block`, `deflect`, `immune`, `resist`, `reflect` or `evade`. Pair the two and you have a complete swing sequence with outcomes, which is what swing-timer and parry-haste analysis needs. `melee_only=true` narrows the stream to exactly those rows.

**`is_glancing` / `is_crushing`** are recorded on swing-derived rows only. `null` means not applicable or not recorded: they are populated going forward from 2026-08-23 and cannot be backfilled, so older encounters carry null.

**Actor ids** are bare; resolve them once via the /actors endpoint rather than expecting names on every row.

**Page size**: prefer LARGE pages. The cost of this endpoint is per request, not per row, so one request for a whole encounter is far cheaper for both of us than a hundred small ones. Requires the 'events:read' scope.

parameters.name: encounterId
parameters.description: Encounter id. Must belong to reportId.

parameters.name: groups
parameters.description: Comma-separated event groups: damage, healing, overheal, absorb, casts, buffs, debuffs, avoidance, interrupts, dispels, deaths.

parameters.name: event_types
parameters.description: Comma-separated raw event types, combined with groups.

parameters.name: source_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated actor ids to match as the source.

parameters.name: target_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated actor ids to match as the target.

parameters.name: spell_ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated spell ids. -1 is the melee sentinel.

parameters.name: start_ms
parameters.description: Only events at or after this ms offset.

parameters.name: end_ms
parameters.description: Only events at or before this ms offset.

400.description: Unknown event type or group, or a malformed parameter.

get.description: Maps the bare source_id / target_id values on the event stream to names and types (player, pet, creature, boss). Fetch once per encounter. Requires the 'events:read' scope.

parameters.description: Encounter id. Must belong to reportId.
